definition: a mix of ingredients in set amounts
description: In an old brick metal workshop lit by a glowing furnace, a young man in a sleeveless shirt and a leather apron places a silver bar onto a pile of copper-coloured metal blocks on the pan of a large old balance scale with a brass arm. He then straightens up, rests his hands on the wooden table and looks at the scale. Brass weights, copper scraps in a tray, a small crucible and tongs lie on the table, and a woman works at the furnace behind him.

de.answer: Er legt einen Silberbarren auf die Waage.
de.question: Was macht der Mann?

es.answer: Está colocando una barra de plata en la balanza.
phrases: inclinarse sobre el banco de trabajo
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo el hombre?

fr.answer: Il pose un lingot d'argent sur la balance.
fr.question: Que fait l'homme ?
